task: binary classification: P(peptide induces IL-6), in the training assays' context. Not secretion amount, dose-response or clinical effect.
features: mean-pooled last-layer ESM2-150M (facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D) over residue positions, BOS/EOS excluded, 640-d

members.name: MLP_adasyn
members.imbalance_scheme: ADASYN oversampling of the training rows

cv_metrics_note: recomputed on the notebook's folds with these members (out-of-fold mean of member probabilities)
cv_design: 5 label-stratified folds, no CD-HIT 0.9-identity cluster crossing folds; metrics at threshold 0.5

training.source: FASTA files merged, duplicates and label conflicts removed
training.final_fit: each member refit on all rows with its imbalance scheme

limits: The notebook's own IL-6 ensemble uses MLP_posw; this version uses MLP_adasyn as requested. Its cross-validated metrics here were computed on the notebook's folds with these members.
Sensitivity is low at the 0.5 threshold; the training set is 11% positive.

Applicability: predict_batch returns an `applicability` assessment per peptide (in_domain, limited_evidence or out_of_domain, with reasons) from the trained length range 8-25 and the positive/negative training counts at that exact length (info.json `domain`); sequence similarity and embedding-distribution checks are not run yet. `in_length_range` is kept.
Probabilities are not comparable across cytokines or calibrated; label is simply probability >= 0.5.
Embeddings in the training project were computed in fp16 on GPU and here in fp32; member probabilities differ by up to about 0.02 on a 40-sequence check per model.
Weights were pickled with an earlier scikit-learn than the one installed here; loading emits a version warning.
provenance: Exported by scripts/export_cytokine_models.py from Models/Cytokine Activation/Weighted_5models (notebook IL-6.ipynb); member source files and SHA-256 are in model_weights/il6_induction_predictor_v1/info.json.
